answer: Put stylometric fingerprint per author at the door and most farms never get in: the check itself is the filter. Faking 579 identities means 579 fresh proofs and 67164 POA at risk, while the honest path risks nothing but a few minutes. What carries the ripple here is verification, the sparrow of cost is what stops the farm, and the mirror of the record keeps every claim checkable. One mechanism, one cost, one public record — and the farm's maths stops adding up.
